utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good, but do we have a clear schedule for who's bringing what and when? I don't want things to get chaotic.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point, Pia. Let's make a sign-up sheet for what people are bringing and what times they can help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a smart idea, Hana. Could we maybe list contact numbers too, in case someone runs late or can't find a parking spot?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I was thinking about the repair drive—I've got that power drill I loaned you last month. You still holding onto it, or can I grab it for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, still got it. I'll bring it by your place in an hour.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll be home. Thanks Leo, that drill will come in handy for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, you coming to the repair drive this weekend? Jerry's donating tools, but I'm a bit worried about spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh definitely, I'm coming Saturday the 15th! And Cleo's already checking her garage for spare parts, so we should have plenty.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's great news! I was fretting about parts, but knowing Cleo's stash, we'll be all set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have some spare parts in my garage. Want me to check what I have that might be useful?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's kind of you, Cleo. I might take you up on that — I've got a chair with a wobbly leg that's been sitting in my shed for months.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'll rummage through my garage this afternoon and see if I have any sturdy brackets or screws that might fix that chair leg!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo! Great to see you. Are you here to help with the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Jules! Yeah, something like that—I think it's a clean-up thing? I just grabbed a bag, but I gotta run in a sec.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, actually it's a repair drive—fixing things like bikes, appliances, and even a water pump. Want me to fill you in quick before you go?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, I keep hearing bits about this repair drive—what's the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it sounds like people are collecting broken electronics to fix up and donate. I was thinking I could help sort through the donations if you're involved too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, sorting sounds perfect—I'm not so handy with a soldering iron, but I can definitely help organize things.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I was just thinking about the repair drive — glad it's moved to Sunday at the community center now, that'll be much better.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Sam, I've been planning this for Saturday at my front porch — did someone change it without telling me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, sorry Eli, I thought you knew. I got a notice that it's been rescheduled to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Sunday at the community center? Got it, I can swing by then—might be a bit late though, as usual.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, Dane—late is better than never! The kids will be happy to see another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'll bring my toolbox, but fair warning—I'm better at breaking things than fixing them!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Mara! Yes, the repair drive is still on this Saturday—hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm definitely coming, and I'll bring the flyers with directions to your place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal! I'll text you my address so you can add it to those flyers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah! I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday. Could use some help if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive! Wait, is that this Saturday or next Sunday? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's this Saturday, Noah! Starts at 9 AM, front porch of the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, just checking in—are we all set for the repair drive this weekend? I've got my toolbox ready and the lemonade prepped!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what time are we kicking off? I need to schedule the fence post.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're starting at 9 AM sharp at the school parking lot—Faye suggested it, and it's perfect for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I'm still confused—are we doing a repair drive or a clean-up this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? Saturday the 15th? That rings a bell... I think I wrote it down somewhere, but I can't find my notes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it is a repair drive then? You're sure that's what they said at the meeting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa, the repair drive's definitely this Saturday at the community center—I just confirmed with Mara, and she's already got the lemonade ready!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Tess, I think there's been a mix-up—the drive was moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, Sunday? But Mara just told me Saturday—oh, this is going to get confusing fast!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, when's the repair drive actually starting? I've got a broken fence post that's been waiting weeks.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, um... Saturday the 15th, I think? Wait, let me check my notes—no, that sounds right. Vik mentioned it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday the 15th? Alright, I'll mark it down. You sure about the time, or is it a show-up-when-you-can thing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we figured out what time the repair drive starts? I want to make sure we have enough parking space for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm not sure about the time either, Pia, but I'll be there whenever with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good you'll have your toolbox, Gus, but if we don't set a time, we might have cars blocking each other in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have some spare parts in my garage. Want me to check what I have that might be useful?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That would be great, Cleo! Vik mentioned you always find the most useful stuff. I'd appreciate any parts you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing! I'll head out to the garage right now and sort through my bins. I remember seeing some screws and wires that might come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Mara! So glad you're here — I'm gathering folks for the repair drive, got a moment to chat about it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Jules! I've already got the lemonade prepped and I'm ready to help organize. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Fantastic, Mara! Could you help me spread the word to the neighbors on Elm Street? I'll handle the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. Thanks for letting me know, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I wanted to make sure you heard — it was rescheduled, so don't show up at my porch tomorrow!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, just heard the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center — that right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, I've got it as Saturday at the park. Who told you Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No, I'm pretty sure I heard it's Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good—so this is a general repair drive then. I'll put my old bike on the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's a great idea, Hana. I can help you look it over if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—I'd appreciate that. Maybe we can check it together before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, remind me what the repair drive is about again? I need the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a community fix-it day where people bring broken stuff and we try to repair it together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, free fixes for junk. Sounds good, I might swing by if I can find the time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, are we definitely doing repairs? I'm still not sure if it's a clean-up or a repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, Kira, I promise it's repairs this Saturday! So dig out that wonky lamp or anything else broken, and come join us. You'll see, it'll be a blast!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just making sure. So I can bring my busted toaster, then?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Uli, I've been hearing about a repair drive in the neighborhood—do you know what it's all about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, yeah, Quinn mentioned it. I might drop by for a bit, if I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great! Do you know when it's happening or what kind of repairs they're focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I've been telling everyone — Saturday the 15th! Cleo's checking her garage for spare parts and I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I've got a hammer and some spare wood. Show me which fence panels need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I already told Cleo about Saturday the 15th — she's checking her garage for spare parts, and I'm bringing my old toaster!
